source: nav_benchmark/frames/0 and its corresponding coda/raw files
modality: OS1 motion-compensated LiDAR, rectified cam0 RGB, dense LiDAR poses

transform.point_frame: sensor XYZ -> pose quaternion [qx,qy,qz,qw] rotation + translation -> crop -> normalized render coordinates

raster: 1536x1024 orthographic top-down render of highest colored surface; nearest splats limited to 3 pixels (~12 cm). Dark areas have no colored measurements. No satellite, aerial, or generated photo.
limitations: Sparse ground-based sampling cannot recover unseen roof surfaces.
Moving objects and residual pose error may leave ghosting.
Camera colors use projected LiDAR samples; no learned texture completion.
Vertical scale is compressed by 0.5 for stacked presentation.
Top reasoning layer and QA remain an authored teaching trace, separate from this recorded example.
